notes:
Boys Incentive: a new QC tab. The manager sets who is doing QC each morning, one person or several, and fills in the sheet count that evening. QC earns its own points a sheet, less its own deduction (4 points and 30% to start with), split equally between everyone on QC that day. Both figures are on the Points per sheet tab.

QC points count everywhere your points do: Per employee, My Incentive (QC days are labelled QC), the leaderboard and payments.

Fixed: the Fill sheets preview now shows the points after the deduction, the same figure the day is credited with.

Permissions: the capability count no longer reads more than the total, and saving no longer fails because of an old, retired permission.
